ffff_framework.findings_goal: Phase 1 inventory complete; Phase 2 uses that to design unified architecture
ffff_framework.flags_goal: CRITICAL: 7 violations in current 31 scripts must be eliminated; design must prevent regressions
ffff_framework.flow_goal: All scripts converge on unified COC writer; indexing and recovery use outputs of that single source; no backdoor writes
ffff_framework.friction_goal: Script sprawl causes maintenance burden, version inconsistency, silent failures; consolidation reduces surface area

critical_context.phase_1_output: Inventory spreadsheet from coc-script-mapping-phase-1: function categories, redundancies, canonical candidates
critical_context.audit_violations: 7 CRITICAL: scripts writing to wrong paths, under .claude/, 7 schema fields unused, 3 missing writers (pollen, honey-renders, droplets)
critical_context.current_pattern: 31 scripts = 5+5+11+10 writes, indexes, audits, recoveries. Design should consolidate to 4-5 core functions

design_scope.unified_coc_writer: Single script handles: COC entry creation, signature + timestamp, path routing (forensics/{date}/{type}/, not .claude/)
design_scope.consolidated_indexer: Reads all COC entries, builds forensic index, validates chain integrity
design_scope.verification_suite: Enforces manifest schema compliance; phases gate quality/belief thresholds; compass edge validation
design_scope.recovery_system: Exports all artifacts for task_id in court-ready format; recovers from B2 if needed
design_scope.deprecation_strategy: Which scripts get deleted? Which get renamed? How do we migrate existing calls?

success_criteria.architecture_doc: Design document with function specs, data flow, API contracts, error handling
success_criteria.unified_writer_spec: Function signature + behavior spec for single COC writer; show how it replaces current 5 variants
success_criteria.migration_guide: How to update existing scripts → call unified writer instead of direct write
success_criteria.schema_validation: Proposed manifest schema (11 required fields) with phase gate logic (quality_score + belief_index → compass_edge)
success_criteria.compass_edge: S if design is feasible and non-breaking; E if uncertain about backward compat (parallel validation); W if major rearchitecture needed
